localizedValues.name: S1
localizedValues.description:
Picnic shelter is a log structure with a cement floor and is situated in a large grassy day use opening on the beach of Lac la Hache. The lake view is unrestricted. The day use area is equipped with a change house and playground for children. Picnic Benches are situated between picnic shelter and beach and are available for anyone using the day use area (including those in the picnic shelter). No designated group parking site. Large groups are encouraged to car-pool; 2 adjacent day use parking lots are available accommodating approximately 20-30 vehicles.
Liquor can only be consumed on registered campsites by legal adults. Drinking alcohol is prohibited in all day-use and public frontcountry areas, including campground washrooms and roadways.
